verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents AI that automatically flags anomalous or out-of-policy transactions for review. Auto-enforced budget controls, procurement approval flows, the AI expense assistant and the MCP server are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not this capability. Spend-policy anomaly flagging is a fair axis for a spend platform, so absence of evidence is "none".

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI flag anomalous or out-of-policy transactions automatically for review
